entries.what: Slept in until 9, then studied her tabbed network guide at the Verdant Commons desk with a practice-test app before leaving for the 2 p.m. swing shift.
entries.outcome: Finished two practice quizzes before work.

entries.what: Worked the help desk in the cage at RF-4, swapping dead scanner batteries and updating the RMA sheet.
entries.outcome: Cleared the cage backlog down to about 20 handhelds.

entries.what: Got home after 10:30 and played the co-op survival game with her squad before bed.
entries.outcome: Went to bed near 1 a.m.

entries.what: Opened her self-review draft in the morning and cut it down hard, calling it the boss fight, before the self-review deadline that evening.
entries.outcome: Trimmed the draft to half its length and submitted it.

entries.what: Taught Bao scanner trigger-board swaps from 3 to 5 p.m. in the cage.
entries.outcome: Bao completed two swaps unassisted.

entries.what: Ate a leftover rice bowl at her desk during the handoff, then handled Carla's text about a dead scanner on the outbound dock.
entries.outcome: Swapped the unit and sent it to the cage.

entries.what: Late morning at home she did subnetting drills, her weakest topic, and picked up an iced black coffee on the way to work.
entries.outcome: Missed half the drills.

entries.what: Spent the swing shift reimaging laptops and logging tickets in the internal queue, with Greg mostly out of sight in his office.
entries.outcome: Finished the laptop batch alone.

entries.what: Watched a show with Iris after shift on their shared streaming account.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep on the couch.

entries.what: Before shift she worked out wording for a short lecture to the night crew about sharing badge PINs.
entries.outcome: Had a tight three-point script for the huddle.

entries.what: Trained Bao on scanner repairs from 3 to 5 p.m., then gave the badge PIN talk to the night pickers at handoff.
entries.outcome: Several pickers promised to stop sharing PINs.

entries.what: Got home to Iris's Thursday sushi order.
entries.outcome: Shared a roll and talked about the weekend.

entries.what: Ate lunch at home and fixed her parents' printer remotely after her mom called about it.
entries.outcome: Printer working again.

entries.what: Greg called the IT desk together and announced he was giving two weeks' notice, leaving Oct 17.
entries.outcome: Noemi realized the lead duties would land on the desk, likely on her.

entries.what: Picked up Taquería Colima for dinner at work as usual on Friday.
entries.outcome: Ate while sorting the RMA sheet.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the morning with her coffee.
entries.outcome: Cleared her head about Greg leaving.

entries.what: Studied network chapters at the desk with the practice-test app for a couple of hours.
entries.outcome: Got through two chapters.

entries.what: Went to dinner with Iris and told her about Greg's notice.
entries.outcome: Iris encouraged her to go for the lead role.

entries.what: Slept late, then helped her parents at the Vinca Avenue fourplex with a phone problem.
entries.outcome: Fixed it in ten minutes.

entries.what: Did subnetting drills and a practice exam in the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Scored in the low 70s.

entries.what: Played the co-op survival game with her squad in the evening as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Won a long session.
